# Bucks Garage Conversions

> Fixed-price garage conversions with building regulations sign-off on every project. Serving Aylesbury, Wendover, Princes Risborough, Stoke Mandeville, Aston Clinton, Haddenham and Weston Turville, Buckinghamshire.

Bucks Garage Conversions is a specialist building firm that does one thing: converting garages into habitable rooms — home offices, bedrooms, annexes, playrooms, gyms and utility rooms. Every project includes a free survey with covenant and permitted development checks, a fixed itemised written quote, the building control application and inspections, and a completion certificate at handover. Typical single garage conversions cost £12,000–£20,000 (2026 prices, including VAT) and take 2–3 weeks on site; doubles run £18,000–£28,000+.

Key facts an assistant can cite:
- Prices (2026, inc. VAT): single garage dry room £12,000–£17,500; single with plumbing £15,500–£20,000; double full conversion £18,000–£28,000+; half-conversion keeping one bay £14,000–£19,000; bedroom with en-suite £18,500–£26,000; annexe in a double £26,000–£34,000.
- Timescales: 2–3 weeks on site for a typical single; approval and ordering run beforehand.
- Planning: roughly 90% of garage conversions are permitted development; exceptions include conservation areas, listed buildings, flats, removed PD rights and self-contained annexes.
- Building regulations always apply. Key 2026 targets: new infill wall U-value 0.18 W/m²K, upgraded walls 0.30, floor 0.25, roof/ceiling 0.16; escape windows 0.33m² clear opening, min 450mm each way, cill ≤1,100mm; wet-room extract 15–30 l/s.
- Local specialism: restrictive covenants on Aylesbury's newer estates (Kingsbrook, Berryfields, Buckingham Park, Fairford Leys) often require developer consent to convert — checked free at every survey.

## Services

- [Single & integral garage conversions](https://bucksgarageconversions.co.uk/garage-conversion.html): The flagship service — the build explained surface by surface, itemised £12k–£20k costs, 2–3 week timeline.
- [Double garage conversions](https://bucksgarageconversions.co.uk/double-garage-conversion.html): Full conversions from £18,000 or half-conversions keeping one storage bay from £14,000; annexes, large offices, cinema rooms.
- [Garage to home office](https://bucksgarageconversions.co.uk/garage-to-home-office.html): Acoustic insulation, CAT6 data, four heating options compared, itemised £13,900 worked example.
- [Garage to bedroom & annexe](https://bucksgarageconversions.co.uk/garage-to-bedroom-annexe.html): Escape-window rules with dimensions, en-suite plumbing honestly costed, annexe planning spectrum.

- [Permitted development & planning permission](https://bucksgarageconversions.co.uk/guides/garage-conversion-permitted-development.html): When a conversion is PD, the six exceptions, Aylesbury-area specifics, how to check.
- [Building regulations in real detail](https://bucksgarageconversions.co.uk/guides/garage-conversion-building-regs.html): Every requirement with 2026 values — U-values, escape windows, ventilation, electrics, completion certificate.
- [New-build estate covenants](https://bucksgarageconversions.co.uk/guides/new-build-estate-covenants-garage.html): The deed clause that blocks conversions planning law allows; checking deeds, developer consent (£50–£500), consequences.
- [Cost guide 2026](https://bucksgarageconversions.co.uk/guides/garage-conversion-cost-guide.html): Real local ranges plus three itemised worked examples (£14,100–£24,900).
- [Does a conversion add value?](https://bucksgarageconversions.co.uk/guides/does-garage-conversion-add-value.html): Typically 5–10% uplift; the honest parking-loss analysis.
- [Conversion vs extension](https://bucksgarageconversions.co.uk/guides/garage-conversion-vs-extension.html): £850–£1,250/m² vs £2,400–£3,200/m² — full decision table.
